# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty-three  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P30](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0030), [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P54](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0054), [v5 c10 P42](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0042)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c6 P32](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

In his middle life, Marshall Elliott possessed an extraordinary appearance with long, iron-gray hair reaching his waist and a long beard, resulting from his political vow. Anne once mistook his towering figure for a dime museum freak or Viking of elder days. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he looked entirely unrecognizable to his acquaintances. He is a big, hearty man who is as strong as an ox.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who enjoys telling good stories and singing old ballads. He has a determined, stubborn streak characteristic of the Elliott family, as well as a temper that occasionally flares up. He exhibits a lighthearted, humorous attitude and rarely takes things too seriously, which sometimes annoys his wife. Additionally, he possesses a strong sense of compassion, particularly regarding the mistreatment of children.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014), [v5 c26 P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011)_

## History

Marshall Elliott was born into a staunchly political family of Elliotts at Four Winds. Fifteen years prior to meeting Anne, he made a public vow during a fierce election campaign that he would not cut his hair or shave his face until the Liberal (Grit) party came into power. Because the Liberals suffered repeated defeats, he remained unkempt for fifteen years, becoming a well-known eccentric figure in the community. During this time, he maintained a friendship with Captain Jim and spent time cod-fishing. When the Liberals finally won the election, he immediately forced the local barber to trim his hair and shave his beard, startling his household and neighbors. Shortly after his transformation, he married Cornelia Bryant and moved into her house, where he planted trees, a spruce hedge, and a rose garden. When the plight of the orphan Mary Vance was brought to light, he investigated the situation over-harbour and agreed to take her into their home.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P12](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0012), [v5 c9 P39](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0039), [v5 c9 P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042)_
